% A \par in \title in scrreprt, whose title page writes the title through
% a tex4ht configuration of its own, and from a robust macro. The document
% builds, and the page's title holds the text.
\documentclass{scrreprt}
\DeclareRobustCommand\br{\par}
\title{Main\par Title\br Robust}
\author{Someone}
\begin{document}
\maketitle
Some text.
\end{document}
